{{Quote|This isn't the ''best'' idea you ever had, Han. Without visible stars, the ''navicomp'' can't take our bearings.''"<br />"''I know. These gas clouds can go on for ''light years''.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="DEII4" />}}
The '''Oktos Nebula''' was a large, highly [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] covering the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]] that effectively isolated the planet from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its outer drifts reached the fringes of the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]]. The [[Oktos Route]] skirted along the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].

==History==
[[File:Ganath_Cloud.jpg|thumb|left|245px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] travels through the Oktos Nebula and enters [[Ganathan Space]].]]
During the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Empatojayos Brand]] was shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] near the cloud where he fell through and discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]]. As a result of this, Brand became the planet's [[King/Legends|king]].

While fleeing [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] went directly through the cloud to lose them, running into Ganath patrols. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] began patrolling around the cloud, waiting for the ''Falcon'' to come out. After being equipped with the [[Lightning gun (Ganath)|lightning gun]], the ''Falcon'' left Ganath and sent ''Slave I'' spiraling into the clouds.
